audit_log_source_shape.name: audit_log_source_shape
audit_log_source_shape.value: ("audit_log"."source" in ('installation') and "audit_log"."installation_id" is not null) or ("audit_log"."source" in ('url') and "audit_log"."installation_id" is null)

brief_anchor_reason_shape.name: brief_anchor_reason_shape
brief_anchor_reason_shape.value: ("brief"."anchor_state" in ('fresh-restart') and "brief"."anchor_reason" in ('model-swap')) or ("brief"."anchor_state" is distinct from 'fresh-restart' and "brief"."anchor_reason" is null)

generation_kind_baseline_shape.name: generation_kind_baseline_shape
generation_kind_baseline_shape.value: ("generation"."kind" in ('brief') and "generation"."baseline_sha" is null) or ("generation"."kind" in ('delta', 'revision-narrative') and "generation"."baseline_sha" is not null)

pull_request_owner_shape.name: pull_request_owner_shape
pull_request_owner_shape.value: ("pull_request"."source" in ('installation') and "pull_request"."installation_id" is not null and "pull_request"."owner_user_id" is null) or ("pull_request"."source" in ('url') and "pull_request"."installation_id" is null and "pull_request"."owner_user_id" is not null)

review_draft_comment_anchor_shape.name: review_draft_comment_anchor_shape
review_draft_comment_anchor_shape.value: ("review_draft_comment"."kind" in ('line') and "review_draft_comment"."side" is not null and "review_draft_comment"."start_line" is not null and "review_draft_comment"."end_line" is not null and "review_draft_comment"."start_line" > 0 and "review_draft_comment"."end_line" > 0 and ("review_draft_comment"."start_side" is not null or "review_draft_comment"."end_line" >= "review_draft_comment"."start_line")) or ("review_draft_comment"."kind" in ('file') and "review_draft_comment"."start_line" is null and "review_draft_comment"."end_line" is null and "review_draft_comment"."side" is null and "review_draft_comment"."start_side" is null)
